title: In bulk mode a click anywhere on a row ticks it instead of opening it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click part A's description in its row.
  5. Click part A's Category cell.
  6. Click part B's Part Number cell.
  7. Click the checkbox at the left of the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The bar shows 0 in its round badge, followed by "selected", and every row has an empty checkbox.

Step 4:

  • The part A row is ticked and the badge reads 1.
  • No part window opens.

Step 5:

  • The part A row is unticked and the badge reads 0.
  • No window opens.

Step 6:

  • The part B row is ticked and the badge reads 1.
  • No window opens.

Step 7:

  • The part B row is unticked and the badge reads 0.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)
